annotations.title: Latin American central bank policy rates

description: Return the monetary policy rate of Chile (TPM), Brazil (Selic target), Mexico (target rate), Colombia and Peru, each with its central bank, date and source. Peru publishes a monthly series, so it returns a YYYY-MM period. Partial results list the central banks that did not answer. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /latam/tasas-politica via x402.

paises.description: Comma-separated subset of CL, BR, MX, CO, PE; default all.
